title: Native died of police beating, chief says

The _RCMP_ have launched an internal probe into the death of \[_Paul_ _Alphonse_\], a chronic alcoholic and street person.
An elderly native man who died after an alleged police beating had four broken ribs and a compressed vertebral fracture, his family and band chief say.
_Paul_ _Alphonse_, 67, of Williams Lake, B.C., died in hospital Tuesday, a week after he was taken there from jail.
The _RCMP_ have launched an internal probe into the death of _Alphonse_, a chronic alcoholic and street person.
